newsitem.title: ITALY: ITALY OFFERS 5.0 TRLN LIRE BONDS, CERTIFICATES.
newsitem.headline: ITALY OFFERS 5.0 TRLN LIRE BONDS, CERTIFICATES.

text.p: The Italian Treasury said it will issue a total of 5.0 trillion lire of medium to long-term paper for sale at its regular mid-month auction.
The Treasury said in a statement said it would offer:
* 1.5 trillion lire of three-year fixed rate bonds (BTP) paying a 6.0 percent coupon.
* 2.0 trillion lire of five-year 6.25 percent BTPs
Subscriptions for the auctions close at 1100 GMT on August 18. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
